run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T16:47:15Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is explained by the ad service being unavailable: the ad container in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 has been repeatedly OOMKilled (exit 137, restartCount 4, BackOff events starting 16:46:29Z), the ad Deployment reports Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 16:49:32Z), and the ad Service's Endpoints object holds no ready address. Frontend's error spans are confined to the /api/data request path and its client call grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds: 552 error spans on each of SERVER 'GET', SERVER 'GET /api/data', INTERNAL 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and CLIENT 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' over 15:47:15-17:04:31Z, while every other frontend operation had zero error spans. Timing lines up: frontend error-span rate was 0 through 16:46:00Z, became 1.57/s at 16:47:00Z and stayed 1.9-3.1/s to 16:56:00Z (total frontend span rate 28-38/s), exactly while ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server-span rate fell from ~0.5-0.7/s to 0.2/s at 16:47:00Z and 0/s from 16:48:00Z onward - i.e. the failing calls never reached the ad server. The alert's reported current value 2.622222222222222 matches the observed frontend error-span rate readings of 2.622222222222222/s at 16:51:00Z and 16:55:00Z. ad's own GetAds server spans carry no ERROR status (only STATUS_CODE_UNSET), its only error spans are pre-existing flagd EventStream timeouts (~1 per 10 min before and after the onset), and the ad container logged only routine request lines until 16:45:20Z with no exception before it died - consistent with an out-of-memory SIGKILL rather than an application-level error. Frontend, frontend-proxy and all other otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts; frontend's other gRPC client calls (cart, checkout, product-catalog, recommendation) show zero errors, and frontend-proxy additionally recorded 553 error 'router frontend egress' client spans and 569 error 'ingress' server spans, consistent with propagating frontend's 5xx responses. Open question: sampled container memory (working set and max_usage peaking at 372MB/355Mi, failcnt 0) stayed below the 450Mi limit, so the precise memory source of the OOMKill is not fully proven - the 60s scrape interval may have missed the peak.

claims.text: Over 2026-11-16T15:47:15Z-17:04:31Z, frontend's error spans are confined to the /api/data path: 552 error spans each on SPAN_KIND_SERVER 'GET', SPAN_KIND_SERVER 'GET /api/data', SPAN_KIND_INTERNAL 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and SPAN_KIND_CLIENT 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', plus ~19.28 on SPAN_KIND_INTERNAL 'tcp.connect'; every other frontend operation (cart, checkout, product catalog, recommendation, render/resolve routes) had 0 error spans.

For the same window frontend's CLIENT span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' has 552 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans against 1354.63 non-error spans, i.e. 1906.6 total, while its CLIENT spans to CartService, CheckoutService, ProductCatalogService and RecommendationService recorded no error spans.

Frontend's error-span rate was 0 at 16:46:00Z, 1.5667/s at 16:47:00Z and 1.89-3.09/s from 16:48:00Z through 16:56:00Z, including 2.622222222222222/s at 16:51:00Z and 16:55:00Z, while total frontend span rate stayed 27.9-38.2/s over the same minutes.

The ad service stopped serving GetAds: its SERVER span rate for 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' was 0.50-0.70/s through 16:46:00Z, dropped to 0.20/s at 16:47:00Z and was 0/s from 16:48:00Z to 16:56:00Z, while frontend kept issuing the same client calls.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (container 'ad') has restartCount 4, ready=false, started=false; its container current state is terminated with reason OOMKilled and exitCode 137 (finishedAt 2026-11-16T16:49:31Z) and its lastState is also terminated OOMKilled exitCode 137 (finishedAt 2026-11-16T16:48:29Z).

kubelet Warning events for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 record reason BackOff, message 'Back-off restarting failed container ad in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5_otel-demo(...)', count 23, from 2026-11-16T16:46:29Z to 2026-11-16T16:54:08Z.

Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo has spec.replicas 1, status.unavailableReplicas 1, and condition Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 2026-11-16T16:49:32Z; its container 'ad' (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) has memory limit 450Mi, memory request 225Mi, cpu limit 50m and no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe.

The Endpoints object for Service ad (selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad, port 8080) contains no ready addresses; its only subset lists notReadyAddresses ['100.96.2.230'] with targetRef Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5.

The ad container's log stream shows only routine lines ('no baggage found in context', 'Targeted ad request received for [...]', 'Non-targeted ad request received, preparing random response.') from 2026-11-16T16:45:01Z until it stops at 16:45:20Z; no exception or shutdown line is present in the logs before the container died.

Sampled memory of the ad container rose from 342,274,048 bytes (~326Mi) at 16:25:00Z to 371,867,648 bytes (~355Mi) at 16:45:00Z and then plateaued; cadvisor max_usage_bytes for the long-lived container instance is 372,563,968 bytes, and container_memory_failcnt is 0 for every ad container instance in the window.

Node i-0d81a0f472ebdc704, which hosts the ad pod and 18 other otel-demo pods, reports Ready=True, MemoryPressure=False ('kubelet has sufficient memory available'), and 16,064,772Ki allocatable memory.
All 21 otel-demo pods are in phase Running and every pod except ad-554b849958-l9ft5 has 0 container restarts and ready=true, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-xfrh6.
Cluster-wide error spans for the window are frontend 2227.28, frontend-proxy 1122.26, ad 2.03, fraud-detection 3.05 and recommendation 3.04; accounting and payment recorded 0.
frontend-proxy recorded 553.01 error CLIENT spans named 'router frontend egress' and 569.25 error SERVER spans named 'ingress' in the window.

ad's only error spans are CLIENT 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' (2.03 in the window) carrying rpc.grpc.status_code=4 and otel.status_description 'stream closed due to server-side timeout', with paired flagd-side spans; ad's SERVER spans for 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (1348.54 in the window) carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

The low-rate error spans of ad, fraud-detection and recommendation occur at about 1 per 10-minute bucket in windows ending 16:40:00Z, 16:50:00Z and 17:00:00Z, i.e. both before and after the 16:47 error onset, and are not onset-aligned.

The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is caused by the ad service being unreachable: the ad container began OOM-killing at ~16:46Z, its pod never became ready, the ad Endpoints object has no ready address, so frontend's /api/data route failed on its CLIENT call to grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and returned errors, which is the only frontend operation with error spans.

The ad container is being killed because its memory use reaches the 450Mi limit configured on Deployment ad (request 225Mi); the recorded reason OOMKilled/exit 137 supports this, but the sampled peak (max_usage_bytes 372,563,968 bytes, ~355Mi) is below the limit, so either the peak fell between 60s kubelet scrapes or the kill came from a different memory pressure source. The underlying reason memory grows in the demo:2.1.3-ad container (e.g. heap growth/leak) is not established by the available evidence.

frontend-proxy's 553.01 error 'router frontend egress' client spans and 569.25 error 'ingress' server spans are the propagation of frontend's failing /api/data responses through the proxy rather than an independent failure, since frontend-proxy's pod is Ready with 0 restarts and its failing spans are its inbound/outbound HTTP spans for frontend traffic. The identity of individual requests between the two services was not verified.

Sampled ad container memory did not reach the configured 450Mi limit: container_memory_working_set_bytes and container_memory_usage_bytes top out at ~372MB (~355Mi) and container_memory_max_usage_bytes at 372,563,968 bytes, with container_memory_failcnt 0, so the exact cgroup/limit mechanism behind the OOMKilled flag is not proven at the available 60s sampling resolution.

A node-level memory cause is not supported: node i-0d81a0f472ebdc704 reports MemoryPressure=False and Ready=True with 16GB allocatable, and all other otel-demo pods on that node (18 of them) have 0 restarts. Node memory series (node_memory_*) are not present in this Prometheus, so node memory availability during the incident could not be measured.

The frontend process itself is not the failing component: pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is Running and ready with 0 restarts, frontend kept producing 27.9-38.2 spans/s, and all of its gRPC client calls other than AdService/GetAds recorded zero error spans; in sampled traces its /api/cart, /api/checkout and /api/products/{productId} requests returned http.status_code 200.

flagd EventStream timeouts are not the cause of this alert: ad's own GetAds server spans carry no ERROR status, the flagd stream errors run at ~1 per 10-minute bucket both before and after the 16:47 onset, and the 552 failing GetAds calls never reached the ad server (its GetAds rate fell to 0/s).

A rollout or reschedule of the ad workload is not the trigger: only one ReplicaSet exists for Deployment ad (ad-554b849958, created 2026-11-16T16:08:51Z with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad), the same creation time as the rest of the namespace and the pod itself, and no new ReplicaSet appeared during the incident.

Give Deployment ad memory headroom above its observed working set (e.g. raise the 450Mi limit and/or right-size the JVM heap for ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad), then verify that the container stops being OOMKilled and that pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 becomes Ready so the ad Endpoints object gains a ready address.

Add readiness/liveness (or startup) probes to the ad container of Deployment ad; it currently has none, so availability depends solely on container readiness after a crash, and a slow-starting but unhealthy container would not be distinguished from a healthy one.

gaps: The alerting rule itself could not be inspected: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name 'RequestErrorRate' and with type=alert both returned no data, so the alert expression, threshold and for-duration are unknown (and its 'current: 2.622222222222222' value is only matched, not verified, against the observed error-span rate).

Span metrics (traces_span_metrics_calls_total) for every service stop at 2026-11-16T16:56:00Z/16:57:00Z in this Prometheus, so frontend's error rate after ~16:57Z is unknown; only the ad pod/Endpoints state at 17:05-17:06Z shows the condition continuing.

Jaeger holds no frontend error trace in the window (newest traces observed at 16:37Z and 16:44Z), so the gRPC status code and error detail returned to frontend on the 552 failing GetAds calls were not observed.
frontend container logs were unreadable (0 bytes returned from pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx for 16:40-17:04Z), so there is no application-side error text for the failing /api/data requests.

No node memory series (node_memory_*) exist in this Prometheus and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="otel-demo",deployment="ad"} returned no data, so node memory headroom and the ad availability metric timeline during the incident are unknown.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so whether the ad memory limit, image or configuration changed shortly before 16:46Z cannot be verified.
The exact mechanism by which the ad container hit OOM (cgroup limit versus another memory pressure source) is unresolved because sampled memory peaked at ~372MB against a 450Mi limit.
next_steps: Correct the RequestErrorRate rule mismatch: confirm the alert expression in the Prometheus/Alertmanager rule files, since list_prometheus_rules returned no rules for this alert name.

Inspect ad container memory at a finer resolution (cadvisor 10-15s scrape or container_memory_max_usage at kill time) or read the container's previous-instance logs after the next restart to capture the last lines before SIGKILL.
Check whether Deployment ad has been changed (memory limit/image tag) via the change-history source that is not integrated here, and compare with the fleet default for this chart version.
Verify whether the ad service (demo:2.1.3-ad) has a known memory-growth issue by profiling its heap over a 30-60 minute run.
Add alerting on pod crash-looping/OOMKilled and on ad Endpoints having zero ready addresses so this dependency failure is visible directly rather than only as a frontend error rate.
